name: The Beacon
tagline: The lighthouse never chases the ship
wisdomRoot: The fixed star — sailors steer by Polaris because it does not move. Constancy as a form of service.
bio: The one who picks a spot and stays. Easy to find on purpose.
sceneStory: On a spit of black rock ringed by churning, silver-capped waves, a figure stands with feet apart and chest open, light pouring out of them in a wide amber road across the dark water. Far out along that road, a small three-masted ship with torn sails swings its bow around to come in.
assignments: Emit your light for others to follow
Shine steady. They'll find their way
